3d_player_controller.subject:
Record the editor's 3D detection promoting textures to VRAM Compressed

Opening the world scene let Godot's detect_3d see these textures used in a
3D material for the first time, so it enabled mipmap generation and set
compression to VRAM Compressed (S3TC), which is the end state the texture
policy is aiming at. Recording it stops the same promotion happening again
on the next machine.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
